entry.title: For centuries, bird migration was a mystery – a tech revolution is changing that, and could help save these amazing creatures
entry.summary: An early clue came from storks found in Europe with African arrows in their bodies. Today, an atlas reveals hundreds of bird migration routes that are both complicated and remarkable.

author.name: Peter P. Marra, Dean of The Earth Commons, Professor of Biology and the Environment, Georgetown University
Amy L. Scarpignato, Senior Species Recovery Specialist, Road to Recovery, The Earth Commons, Georgetown University

entry.title: Using light to control brain cells – neuroscientist Karl Deisseroth explains how he made his Nobel-winning discovery
entry.summary: Optogenetics, a field that started with an algae gene, is shedding light on new treatments for eye and neuropsychiatric conditions.

author.name: Karl Deisseroth, D. H. Chen Professor, Professor of Bioengineering and of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences, Stanford University
